title: Real keys — MATERIAL KERAK
caption: 🔍 Real keys: [jo'natma nega ushlanib qoldi — bir jumlada] 📦 Nima keldi: [tovar, taxminiy qiymati, qaysi kanal — pochta yoki kuryer] ⛔ Muammo: [nima sabab bo'ldi — masalan, tovar nomi noaniq, qiymati ko'rsatilmagan, ruxsatnoma talab qilingan] 🛠 Qanday hal qilindi: [qadamlar: qaysi hujjat, qayerga murojaat, necha kunda] ✅ Xulosa: [boshqalar bu xatoning oldini qanday oladi — 1–2 jumla] 📄 Asos: [hujjat, raqam, sana, band — lex.uz] Shunga o'xshash holatga tushdingizmi? Vaziyatingizni ko'rib chiqib, yo'l ko'rsataman 👇 💬 Maslahat olish ➖➖➖ @Pochtam_shopo #keys
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Clean, modern 3D-minimal style, calm and trustworthy. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape behind the upper half.

1) Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#keys".
2) Center: a matte cardboard parcel on a customs inspection counter, a large indigo magnifying glass hovering over its label, and a small checklist clipboard beside it. Render it as a soft 3D clay illustration with matte surfaces in white and indigo (#4F46E5) with small touches of amber (#F59E0B); soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, generous space around it.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold near-black (#11111B) headline, at most two lines: "Real keys"
4) Under the headline, a smaller medium-grey line: "Jo'natma nega ushlanib qoldi"
5) Bottom, above a thin light divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo".

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
notes: MATERIAL KERAK: kvadrat qavslarni o'zingizning real holatingiz bilan to'ldiring. Ism, jo'natma raqami, aniq sana va tanib olinadigan tafsilot yozmang — faqat mexanika. Pullik maslahat havolasi config.json dagi consult_url dan olinadi.
